custom_logic_notes: The EA uses a dual-indicator approach: RSI with a Moving Average applied to the RSI values (MA-on-RSI). Entry signals use previous bar values (shift=1) for crossover detection to avoid repainting. Digit adjustment is applied: SL/TP values are multiplied by 10 when _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001 (standard 5-digit broker adjustment). Position sizing uses a conditional scheme: if Lots input is negative, the absolute value is used as fixed lots; if positive, it represents a fraction of free margin scaled by MarginPercent input.
python_conversion_notes: RSI is straightforward with ta-lib or pandas-ta. The MA-on-RSI pattern requires computing RSI first, then applying a simple moving average to the RSI series. Ensure crossover detection uses previous completed bar values (shift=1) not current bar. Digit adjustment logic must replicate the _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001 check for SL/TP pip-to-price conversion. The conditional lot sizing (negative=fixed, positive=margin fraction) must be preserved.
